description:
PlanetSpark is a leading EdTech company revolutionizing learning for kids and young adults. We empower the next generation with in\-demand skills like coding, AI, design, and more. Join our mission to ignite a lifelong love of learning!
 



  





 Mission Statement:
 



 Drive revenue growth by achieving ambitious weekly targets through consultative inside sales techniques, focusing on high\-intent nurtured leads.
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



 As a Business Development, you will play a crucial role in guiding and enrolling parents/adult learners into our transformative programs. You'll engage with warm leads who have already experienced a demo class, building strong relationships and facilitating a smooth enrollment journey.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Lead Engagement: Engage with 65\-70 highly qualified leads daily through personalized communication (calls, video sessions, etc.).
* Sales Mastery: Manage the entire sales lifecycle, from initial engagement to successful enrollment.
* Consultative Selling: Conduct personalized video counseling sessions, expertly pitch trial classes, and effectively address client concerns and objections.
* Revenue Generation: Achieve and consistently exceed weekly revenue targets, contributing significantly to company growth.
* Client Onboarding: Ensure a seamless onboarding experience for all new clients.
* Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in training programs to enhance your sales skills and stay updated on industry best practices.



  





 What Sets Sales at PlanetSpark Apart:
 


* High\-Intent Leads: Work exclusively with pre\-qualified leads who have already shown interest in our programs.
* Unparalleled Training: Receive comprehensive, instructor\-led training, combined with on\-the\-job mentorship for continuous professional development.
* Accelerated Growth: Enjoy rapid career progression opportunities with competitive compensation and lucrative incentives.
* Recognition \& Rewards: Be celebrated for your achievements through weekly rewards ceremonies and exclusive recognition programs.
* Positive Impact: Contribute to a meaningful mission by empowering the next generation with essential 21st\-century skills.



  





 Key Skills for Success:
 


* Communication Maestro: Possess exceptional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills (both verbal and written).
* Sales \& Negotiation: Proven ability to influence decisions, handle objections effectively, and close deals confidently.
* Customer\-Centric: Strong empathy and a genuine desire to understand and meet client needs.
* Results\-Oriented: Highly motivated with a strong work ethic and a relentless drive to achieve targets.
* Adaptability \& Resilience: Thrive in a dynamic environment and can quickly adapt to changing priorities.
* Tech\-Savvy: Comfortable using CRM software and other sales tools.



  





 Qualifications:
 



 Education: 2023, 2024, or 2025 graduates (Bachelor's or Master's degree preferred)
 



 Location: Must be based in Gurgaon or willing to relocate.
 



 Availability: This is an office\-based role requiring six working days per week (Tuesday off). Availability on Saturdays and Sundays is essential.
 



  





 Why Join PlanetSpark?
 



 Be a Part of Something Big: Join a fast\-growing EdTech company making a significant impact on the future of education.
 



 Unleash Your Potential: Accelerate your sales career with high\-growth potential and the opportunity to work with a talented and supportive team.
 



 Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy a rewarding career with a company that values work\-life balance and employee well\-being.
 


* Make a Difference: Contribute to a meaningful mission by empowering the next generation with in\-demand skills.

title: 🚀 We’re Hiring: Sales Consultant – API Sales | BFSI
description:
We’re looking for a driven Business Sales Consultant to grow our API business across Banks, NBFCs, Insurance Companies, Fintechs, and other BFSI institutions.
 



  





 What you’ll do:
 



 • Drive end\-to\-end B2B/ SAS Services sales from prospecting to closure.
 



 • Build relationships with CXOs, Business, Product, Digital \& Technology leaders.
 



 • Identify new enterprise opportunities and build a strong sales pipeline.
 



 • Lead product demos, POCs, RFPs, commercial negotiations and closures.
 



 • Work with Product, Technology and Solutions teams to deliver customer\-specific solutions.
 



 • Drive revenue growth, account expansion and strategic partnerships.
 



  





 What we’re looking for:
 



 • 4–8 years of experience in B2B Enterprise Sales / Fintech / SaaS / API Sales.
 



 • Proven experience selling to Banks, NBFCs, Insurance Companies or Fintechs.
 



 • Strong understanding of the BFSI ecosystem and enterprise sales cycles.
 



 • Excellent communication, consultative selling and negotiation skills.
 



 • Existing relationships with BFSI decision\-makers will be a strong advantage.
 



 • Ability to understand and articulate API/technology solutions to business and technical stakeholders.
 



 • A proactive sales mind\-set and, most importantly, the ability to initiate conversations and open doors.
 



  





 💡 Don’t have direct experience in BFSI, APIs or fintech? That’s okay!
 



  





 If you are good at sales, communicate exceptionally well, understand technology, are confident speaking with customers, and know how to initiate a conversation and build relationships, we would still love to hear from you. Relevant experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, sales ability and hunger to learn matter just as much.
 



  





 📍 Location: New Delhi (In office) 
 



 💼 Experience: 3\-5years
 



 💰 Compensation: Competitive \+ Performance Incentives
 



 If you’re passionate about Fintech, APIs and enterprise sales, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Recruiter - Bulk Hiring India
description:
**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for an energetic and target\-oriented
 **Recruiter** 
 who can manage
 **bulk hiring across India** 
 for various positions, primarily within
 **Banking Sales, Telecalling/Call Center, Customer Service, BPO, Field Sales, and other entry\-to\-mid\-level roles** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience handling
 **high\-volume recruitment and joining targets** 
 . The recruiter will be responsible for sourcing candidates through multiple channels, screening profiles, coordinating interviews, and ensuring candidates successfully join the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Handle
 **end\-to\-end recruitment** 
 for bulk hiring requirements across India.
* Source candidates for
 **Bank Sales, CASA Sales, Relationship Manager, Field Sales, Telecaller, Customer Service, Call Center, BPO, and similar positions** 
 .
* Generate a high volume of candidates through:
* Job portals
* Social media
* Employee referrals
* WhatsApp/Telegram recruitment groups
* Recruitment databases
* Campus hiring
* Local sourcing and recruitment drives
* Other relevant sourcing channels
* Screen candidates through phone calls and assess them based on job requirements.
* Explain job responsibilities, salary, incentives, location, working hours, and career opportunities to candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews with hiring managers or clients.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Manage the
 **offer\-to\-joining process** 
 and ensure candidates report on their joining date.
* Achieve daily/weekly/monthly
 **candidate sourcing, interview, selection, and joining targets** 
 .
* Maintain accurate candidate data and recruitment trackers.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for recurring and urgent hiring requirements.
* Conduct bulk recruitment drives when required.
* Coordinate with the HR/recruitment team and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements.
* Reduce candidate dropouts and improve offer\-to\-joining ratios.
* Provide regular recruitment reports and updates to management.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong candidate sourcing and screening abilities.
* Experience in
 **bulk/high\-volume recruitment** 
 .
* Ability to handle multiple job openings simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of recruitment/job portals and social media sourcing.
* Strong follow\-up and candidate relationship management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet recruitment targets.
* Good negotiation and convincing skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment trackers.
* Strong understanding of the Indian employment market.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a recruitment team.



  





**Experience** 



* **3–8 years of recruitment experience** 
 preferred.
* Candidates with experience in
 **bulk hiring, banking recruitment, BPO recruitment, sales recruitment, telecalling recruitment, or field\-sales hiring** 
 will be preferred.
* Freshers with excellent communication and strong sourcing/convincing skills may also be considered.
